race.description: 2026 Psp Peak Of The Creek Heat 4
race.comment: CAMERINA (1) produced a very good effort from this barrier over further last time, finishing third and just 1.5 metres from the winner. Better suited back in trip having won twice in a row at this circuit and distance prior. Primary contender. MIKI B NZ (7) showed good improvement last time, coming from the back row for second and just a head from the winner. Has to contend with a very wide draw but should be close to his peak third up. DELIGHTFULLY SWEET (8) draws for a trail and is a player off a last-start win by 7 metres at this circuit and distance. ALWAYS ADORNED (6) must be respected having followed a string of placings with a well-deserved last-start win.
